text:
Situation: Doxorubicin hydrochloride is not on the FDA shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 105 units (33.1 days on hand at 3.2 units/day). Corvale General holds 65.21 units (23.2 days on hand at 2.8 units/day). The labeler is Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show doxorubicin hydrochloride is not listed on the drug shortage database as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks at present usage rates. No FDA shortage designation exists. Proactive purchasing from an available supplier is warranted to prevent a future supply gap.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place purchase order with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Gland Pharma Limited as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below 14 days on hand. Switching suppliers without verifying current FDA inspection status for each manufacturing site.
